blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local air carriers may have to source part of their fuel from cleaner, nonfossil alternatives by 2030, a government official said. Department of Energy (DOE) Undersecretary Alessandro Sales said the agency has discussed with the National Biofuels Board the possibility of requiring a minimum 1 percent sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) blend. READ: PH woos biojet fuel investments “The recommendation is to have a 1 percent SAF (sustainable aviation fuel) mix or mandate by 2030,” he told reporters on the sidelines of the ASEAN Ministers on Energy Meeting in Pasay City.
